Make Model-X MVR Knockoff Artificial Features

Source: R/artificial_features.R
make_knockoff_mvr_features.Rd

Generates model-X MVR (minimum-variance-reconstructability) knockoff features. The S-matrix is solved via solve_mvr() (an R-native coordinate- descent port of knockpy.mrc._solve_mvr_ungrouped), then the knockoff sample is drawn with knockoff::create.gaussian(..., diag_s = S). This is a novel feature exclusive to stablr — the Python STABL library does not implement MVR knockoffs. Inputs above 3 000 predictors fail closed because global exchangeability for a chunked construction has not been established. For supported dimensions, MVR-solver failure falls back to equi; create.gaussian failure falls back to random permutation.

Usage

make_knockoff_mvr_features(
  x,
  n_injected,
  random_state = NULL,
  knockoff_fallback = c("stop", "allow")
)

Arguments

x

Numeric matrix of predictors (samples \(\times\) features).

n_injected

Integer; number of knockoff columns to select.

random_state

Optional integer seed; passed to solve_mvr() for the coordinate-shuffle RNG.

Value

Named list with elements x_augmented, noise_col_indices, and artificial_provenance; see make_rp_features() for details. The retained artificial_provenance$mvr_chunking compatibility field always records that chunking was not applied.
